run_note: Run covering 2026-08-10 -> 2026-08-11, executed 08:15 UTC Tuesday, US pre-market (04:15 ET). NO SIM-INTEGRITY ALERT and no R1 breach. Four new fills, all XRP-USD, all verified clean on price-range (24/7 asset, so the market-hours gate does not apply). No frozen bots: all nine trading books wrote state within a 12-second window at 07:58:50-07:59:02Z. This is the first run in four with a live US session to attribute, and the session had a single dominant driver: the 2026-08-07 weak US jobs report plus the Hormuz escalation lifted the whole commodity and metals complex while SPY was flat, which is why the fleet's three best days (commodity +3.46%, sentiment +3.44%, hunter +3.32%) came from three unrelated strategies. THE ~6-HOUR BLACKOUT IS NOT FIXED AND IS NOW THE LONGEST-RUNNING OPEN FAULT: three more events since the last review at 362.5, 364.1 and 368.1 minutes (2026-08-10 02:33->08:35, 2026-08-10 14:11->20:15, 2026-08-11 01:50->07:59). Seven events in four days, every one within 6 minutes of the same length, which continues to rule out GitHub cron randomness and matches the rebase-conflict poisoning diagnosed last review. Real fleet uptime is about 50% of wall-clock. THE GROK WATCHER IS STILL DARK, now 93.2 hours, on xAI credit exhaustion - so every risk-gated bot has run the entire Hormuz escalation with no live severe-risk veto, and the hype bot's exit rule is structurally unable to fire. Fleet baseline is $9,000 across 9 active bots (stock/TQQQ retired 07-31). Reported only, nothing touched.

THIS RUN: two closures, one of each sign, and both carry a caveat recorded against myself. 2026-08-10-crypto-1 closed +33.63, my largest single win and the seventh straight win in the crypto churn family - but the decomposition says only 7.96 of it was the fee burn I actually argued; the other 25.67 was XRP falling 2.9% on a Senate CLARITY Act delay I did not forecast. Right for mostly the wrong reason. 2026-08-08-sentiment-1 closed -41.81, my second-largest loss, on a reachable reference with no excuse: I read the 08-07 gap-and-fade as a spent catalyst when it was a post-earnings fade. Five of my seven directional losses are now calls against a momentum or hype entry. The distinction that survives the whole sample: telling a hype bot to STAY IN CASH has worked (07-26 +61.39, 07-27 +38.17); telling it to EXIT a position it already holds on my read of entry quality has not.
